epoch_size_rule: fixed constant = n_nonGVR + floor(gvr_cap * n_nonGVR / (1 - gvr_cap)) for the frozen pool; the sampler raises if the pool no longer matches instead of changing it
priority_gvr: supplement post-retrieval trusted-verification items and supplement matched negatives are always included
gvr_step_role_allocation: largest remainder, proportional to pool counts
within_role_selection: document water-filling (fewest effective samples first); ties by sha256(seed:epoch:doc:id)
validation_and_test: never sampled, reweighted, or rebalanced; evaluated at their natural v2.2 distribution, with the memory supplement reported separately
